findings: Owner amendment to an APPROVED and MERGED design, committed at e40677d22ee4cd4a20d9c4b3a034c1283405ec05 over rev 3 at 2ade67f, plus 330 minus 47, one file, nothing pushed. THE RULING FOLDED WITH ITS REASONING PER METAMORPHISM - D2 is struck and superseded by D2-prime with my argument for the strict form left legible above it, so a future reader sees the rule was chosen, argued and overturned rather than finding only the outcome, and section 4a folds the REASONING in a four-row table: the cost objection died by measurement over 99 live launch payloads (the producer sees tool_response.agentId at dispatch and nothing identifying a train, so BOTH directions need the same single input and the asymmetry the conductor asserted to the owner does not exist), the issue-as-index question resolved into already-true (105 of 105 handles encode their issues, but the bare issue is too coarse and not train-unique), the Law 6 drift objection was defeated by the owner on Law 6's own terms (drift needs a copy that CAN change; a sealed append-only record's id cannot, and the DERIVED binding is what changes when the join rule changes, so the stored pointer is the MORE reliable of the two, same reasoning as the budget stamp), and only DIRECTION survived, which the owner decided. The composite key proposed, attacked and withdrawn is kept as scar tissue with all three grounds - it breaks the join, it is redundant since 104 of 105 handles already carry an explicit round, and it manufactures a false-looking fact. FIELD SPECIFIED as members observed_subject in a new section 5.8 - optional, RAW and byte-verbatim, NOT identity, NOT a join key, NOT a liveness source - with the name chosen because section 10 Q1 (the question the owner ruled on) used it, and alternatives ran_as and runtime_subject named and declined with reasons. THE MEASUREMENT THAT SHAPED IT, and it is new work rather than transcription - the ruling flagged reverse-uniqueness and cited the 75 car; I verified that case and then measured the whole store, finding 43 of 109 runtime subjects serve MORE THAN ONE member with 76 distinct shop handles inside those groups, a maximum of FIVE rounds under one runtime id (ab2bd332be0eebc2c carrying one dispatched and five returned, tooling-65-car-r1 through r5), and every one of the 43 groups holding exactly one dispatched record so agent-resume is uniform rather than incidental. That produced D10 - the pointer is provenance and NEVER a liveness source - because the fold keeps one winner per subject, so dereferencing a shared pointer would render rounds 1 through 4 with round 5's outcome, a Law 1 falsehood on four rows in five that would look entirely plausible; section 7 REFUSES dereferencing rather than deferring it, and Q9 states the alternative for attack anyway because it is the obvious reading of the ruling that I did not take. THE FALSIFICATION SWEEP, turned inward as last round, found THREE surviving D2-strict claims of my own - P5's never-the-reverse clause was an OVER-REACH that closed a question the owner owned, so its narrow form survives with a four-row table showing exactly which clause fell; P4's what-changes-if-false prediction had its ANTECEDENT come true and its CONSEQUENT not, because I had assumed recording a runtime id means recording it as identity, and I recorded the miss rather than deleting the prediction; and the V13 empty-by-construction argument rested partly on D2 gives the manifest no runtime fact to mutate toward, which the ruling makes FALSE, so identity immutability now rests on D1 plus V7 alone while the newly-mutable pointer is covered by section 5.8b and V20 rather than V13 - left standing that line would have been a lying canary inside one document. Also corrected: section 9b's round-1 disposition row got an APPENDED rev-4 note rather than a rewrite since it records what rev 1 did, and the header's cap paragraph, because the cap did NOT fire and rev 4 is not a fourth review round. FIVE VECTORS ADDED - V17 folds the approving reviewer's Q5 ruling (BOTH a producer check and a board disclosure, not redundant, using my own Law 6 argument against my own PARTIAL) and moves the last obligation from PARTIAL to complete with the arithmetic restated at 21 vectors none double-counted; V18 pins the pointer raw and byte-verbatim with the WITHDRAWN COMPOSITE as its red half so nobody re-proposes the suffix without tripping a test; V19 pins the many-to-one case and is the vector that protects the whole ruling; V20 pins supersession write-correctness, named as a write error rather than drift because not-drift is not not-checkable; V21 pins absent-is-normal as a NO-BACKFILL guard. ALL FOUR BINDING MINORS FOLDED - DR3-m1 the basis corrected from dispatched-record code to the fold's subject-grouping at Detect-Dispatches.ps1:163-164 with works-today softened to binds-the-moment-such-a-record-exists, and I verified myself that nothing in scripts or board mints presumed-lost, every reference being a reader; DR3-m2 landed as BOTH a section 2c row and a section 8 row with the owner stated as NONE TODAY, transferring to whoever builds the watchdog-tier1 component the vector's own basis.by names, and the reviewer's note that it is not fix-created carried so a later round does not miscount it; DR3-m3 a three-row table naming which ground covers which operation including the direction where V7's precedence is the CAUSE of an identity flip rather than the guard; DR3-m4 Q2's option (ii) split into ii-a reject-the-field and ii-b reject-the-record, with ii-b's Law 4 hazard priced (it manufactures an invisible dispatch, the 32 killed-session class, deliberately by validator) and recommended for outright rejection so the owner's choice is complete rather than quietly narrowed. NO DISAGREEMENT with the ruling or the shape; the one implementation question the ruling did not settle, whether the board dereferences, I decided on measurement and routed as Q9. VERIFICATION - CitationResolver plus DocPolicy plus CodeCitation 43 passed 0 failed 4 skipped, scripts/tests 223 passed 0 failed 4 skipped, and I injected a REV-4 coordinate rather than reusing an earlier one, replacing Produce-Artifact.ps1:25-32 with :666555 and watching the gate red BY NAME at document line 448, with the restore issued as a SEPARATE call per the standing hazard and verified by hash byte-identical at DE12386D47B14B026BB2630EF49F17FF5CC349185226F9B025FCC2E3F782D0DC with zero residue. Shared checkout verified clean, board untouched, one file changed, nothing pushed.
abstract: Rev 4 of the manifest member identity design for issue 87 is an owner amendment to an already-approved and already-merged document, not a fix cycle: rev 3 was approved with zero Majors and merged, and the owner then ruled on the one genuinely open contract question and overturned a decision the design had held since rev 1. The amendment lands as a follow-on commit, one file, plus 330 minus 47. The struck decision and the argument that produced it stay legible above the ruling rather than being rewritten away, and the ruling's reasoning is folded rather than only its conclusion, because three of the four objections the original decision rested on died under measurement rather than argument - including a cost asymmetry the conductor had asserted to the owner that ninety-nine live launch payloads showed does not exist. A composite key that was proposed, attacked on three grounds and withdrawn is preserved as scar tissue so nobody re-proposes it. The substantive new work is a measurement the ruling only gestured at with a single example: across the whole store, thirty-nine percent of runtime subjects serve more than one plan slot because fix cycles resume the same agent, with up to five rounds under one identifier. That measurement produced the amendment's own new decision - the stored pointer records provenance and is never read for liveness - because the fold keeps one winner per subject, so following a shared pointer would show four rounds wearing a fifth round's outcome, plausibly and falsely. The pointer is specified as an optional, raw, non-identity, non-join field, with the many-to-one fact stated rather than assumed and write-correctness across supersession named as an ordinary checkable write error rather than as the drift the ruling had already disposed of. An inward sweep for statements the ruling falsified found three, all the author's own, including one premise clause that had quietly converted a proof of sufficiency into a prohibition the author did not own. Five conformance vectors are added, four binding minors from the approving review are folded, and the last incomplete obligation is closed by the reviewer's own ruling.
